name: Koi Suru Ojou-sama wa Ecchi na Hanayome
original_name: 恋するお嬢様はエッチな花嫁
source:
Masaki used to work as a servant in a mansion, but a certain incident caused him to get fired by the mansion’s owner. A man on the street then helps him to get a new job at another mansion. It’s run by a kind old woman and her steward. The young daughter of the house also lives there together with her best friend.

Masaki’s days get even more lively when the daughter of his previous employer also gets involved, not to mention his childhood friend who he views as a sister from the home that he grew up in. All of the girls have their own personalities, turning this into sudden love story.

Will he walk with one of them down the aisle?

[Edited from [url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/koi-suru-ojou-sama-wa-ecchi-na-hanayome/]Otaku Lair[/url]]
translation:
正树曾在一座宅邸里做佣人，却因一场意外被宅邸主人解雇。街上的一名男子帮助他在另一座宅邸找到新工作。那里由一位慈祥的老妇人和她的管家经营，老妇人的年轻女儿也和她最好的朋友住在那里。

前雇主家的女儿也加入进来后，正树的日子变得更加热闹；此外，还有他从小一起长大、视如妹妹的青梅竹马。女孩们性格各异，一场突如其来的恋爱故事就此展开。

他最终会和其中一人走上婚礼殿堂吗？

[根据 [url=http://www.otakulair.com/games/koi-suru-ojou-sama-wa-ecchi-na-hanayome/]Otaku Lair[/url]内容编辑]
